metas.name: Pink Flamingos
metas.description: Notorious Baltimore criminal and underground figure Divine goes up against a sleazy married couple who make a passionate attempt to humiliate her and seize her tabloid-given title as "The Filthiest Person Alive".

metas.name: Suspiria
metas.description: An American newcomer to a prestigious German ballet academy comes to realize that the school is a front for something sinister amid a series of grisly murders.

metas.name: Law of Desire
metas.description: A gay filmmaker becomes involved with an obsessive fan while still pining for his absent true love. Meanwhile, he shares a close but complex relationship with his trans sister, an actress.

metas.name: Safe
metas.description: An affluent and unexceptional homemaker in the suburbs develops multiple chemical sensitivity.

metas.name: Children of Heaven
metas.description: After a boy loses his sister's pair of shoes, he goes on a series of adventures in order to find them. When he can't, he tries a new way to "win" a new pair.

metas.name: Beau Travail
metas.description: An ex-Foreign Legion officer recalls his once-glorious life of leading troops in Djibouti.

metas.name: Talk to Her
metas.description: Two men share an odd friendship while they care for two women who are both in deep comas.

metas.name: Synecdoche, New York
metas.description: A theater director struggles with his work and the women in his life as he creates a life-size replica of New York City inside a warehouse as part of his new play.

metas.name: Saving Face
metas.description: A gay Chinese-American and her traditionalist mother are reluctant to go public with secret loves that clash against cultural expectations.

metas.name: Silent Light
metas.description: In a Mennonite community in Mexico, a father's faith is tested when he falls in love with a new woman.

metas.name: Drive My Car
metas.description: A renowned stage actor and director learns to cope with a big personal loss when he receives an offer to direct a production of Uncle Vanya in Hiroshima.

metas.name: Great Freedom
metas.description: In post-war Germany, liberation by the Allies does not mean freedom for everyone. Hans is repeatedly imprisoned under Paragraph 175, which criminalizes homosexuality. Over the decades, he develops an unlikely bond with his cellmat...

metas.name: No Other Choice
metas.description: After being fired, a man devises a unique plan to secure a new job: eliminate his competition.

metas.name: A Separation
metas.description: A married couple are faced with a difficult decision - to improve the life of their child by moving to another country or to stay in Iran and look after a deteriorating parent who has Alzheimer's disease.

metas.name: EO
metas.description: Follows a donkey who encounters on his journeys good and bad people, experiences joy and pain, exploring a vision of modern Europe through his eyes.

metas.name: Sentimental Value
metas.description: An intimate exploration of family, memories, and the reconciliatory power of art.

metas.name: The Secret Agent
metas.description: Amid the political turmoil of Brazil in 1977, a technology expert is forced into hiding and seeks help from the underground resistance as he tries to flee the country with his young son.

metas.name: Nouvelle Vague
metas.description: The behind the scenes of the filming of Jean-Luc Godard's Breathless (1960), a landmark of the French New Wave film movement.

metas.name: Primetime
metas.description: In 2006, To Catch a Predator host Chris Hansen sets out to make television history.

metas.name: La bola negra
metas.description: Explores what it means to be gay throughout different eras, focusing on "three existences" that are connected through themes of sexuality, desire, pain, and inheritance.

metas.name: Artificial
metas.description: When computer scientist Ilya Sutskever and AI pioneer Geoffrey Hinton make a breakthrough they're certain will alter humanity forever, the most prominent figures in Silicon Valley race to become a part of their vision. Years later, after a chance meeting with Sam Altman, Sutskever and a group of ide

metas.name: November
metas.description: In a poor Estonian village, a group of peasants use magic and folk remedies to survive the winter, and a young woman tries to get a young man to love her.

metas.name: Hagazussa
metas.description: After the loss of her tormented mother, the erratic behavior of a 15th century woman living in an isolated mountain village becomes a threat to the safety of her infant child.

metas.name: Memoria
metas.description: A woman from Scotland, while traveling in Colombia, begins to notice strange sounds. Soon she begins to think about their appearance.

metas.name: The Chronology of Water
metas.description: A woman, after an abusive childhood, escapes into competitive swimming, sexual experimentation, toxic relationships, and addiction before finding her voice through writing.

metas.name: Die My Love
metas.description: A writer and young mother is suffering post-partum depression and slowly spiralling into madness. Moving into an old house with her husband, she grows more and more agitated and erratic as her mind begins to unravel.

metas.name: TÁR
metas.description: Set in the international world of Western classical music, the film centers on Lydia Tár, widely considered one of the greatest living composer-conductors and the very first female director of a major German orchestra.

metas.name: Perfect Blue
metas.description: A pop singer gives up her career to become an actress, but she slowly goes insane when she starts being stalked by an obsessed fan and what seems to be a ghost of her past.

metas.name: Memento
metas.description: A former insurance investigator who now suffers from anterograde amnesia uses notes and tattoos to hunt down his wife's murderer.

metas.name: All We Imagine as Light
metas.description: In Mumbai, Nurse Prabha's routine is troubled when she receives an unexpected gift from her estranged husband. Her younger roommate, Anu, tries in vain to find a spot in the city to be intimate with her boyfriend.

metas.name: Cry-Baby
metas.description: In 1950s Baltimore, a bad boy with a heart of gold wins the love of a good girl, whose boyfriend sets out for revenge.

metas.name: Minding the Gap
metas.description: Filmmaker Bing Liu searches for correlations between his skateboarder friends' turbulent upbringings and the complexities of modern masculinity.

metas.name: The Shrouds
metas.description: Karsh, an innovative businessman and grieving widower, builds a device to connect with the dead inside a burial shroud.

metas.name: Bugonia
metas.description: Two conspiracy-obsessed young men kidnap the high-powered CEO of a major company, convinced that she is an alien intent on destroying planet Earth.

metas.name: One Battle After Another
metas.description: When their enemy resurfaces after 16 years, a group of ex-revolutionaries reunite to rescue the daughter of one of their own.

metas.name: The Mastermind
metas.description: In 1970, failed architect James Blaine Mooney and cohorts wander into a museum in broad daylight and steal four paintings. When holding onto the art proves more difficult than stealing them, Mooney is relegated to a life on the run.

metas.name: If I Had Legs I'd Kick You
metas.description: While trying to manage her own life and career, a woman on the verge of a breakdown must cope with her daughter's illness, an absent husband, a missing person, and an unusual relationship with her therapist.

metas.name: Sorry, Baby
metas.description: After a tragic event, a woman finds herself alone while everyone else continues with their lives as if nothing had happened.

metas.name: Twinless
metas.description: A young man grieving the loss of his twin brother joins a support group for "twinless twins."

metas.name: 28 Years Later
metas.description: A group of survivors of the rage virus live on a small island. When one of the group leaves the island on a mission into the mainland, he discovers secrets, wonders, and horrors that have mutated not only the infected but other su...

metas.name: The Ugly Stepsister
metas.description: Elvira battles against her gorgeous stepsister in a realm where beauty reigns supreme. She resorts to extreme measures to captivate the prince, amid a ruthless competition for physical perfection.

metas.name: Talk to Me
metas.description: When a group of friends discover how to conjure spirits using an embalmed hand, they become hooked on the new thrill, until one of them goes too far and unleashes terrifying supernatural forces.

metas.name: Border
metas.description: A customs officer who can smell fear develops an unusual attraction to a strange traveler while aiding a police investigation which will call into question her entire existence.

metas.name: Thelma
metas.description: A confused religious girl tries to deny her feelings for a female friend who's in love with her. This causes her suppressed subconsciously-controlled psychokinetic powers to reemerge with devastating results.

metas.name: Saint Maud
metas.description: A pious nurse becomes dangerously obsessed with saving the soul of her dying patient.

metas.name: The Duke of Burgundy
metas.description: A woman who studies butterflies and moths tests the limits of her relationship with her lesbian lover.

metas.name: Weekend
metas.description: After a drunken house party with his straight mates, Russell heads out to a gay club. Just before closing time he picks up Glen but what's expected to be just a one-night stand becomes something else, something special.

metas.name: Good Time
metas.description: After a botched bank robbery lands his younger brother in prison, Connie Nikas embarks on a twisted odyssey through New York City's underworld to get his brother Nick out of jail.

metas.name: Under the Skin
metas.description: A mysterious young woman seduces lonely men in the evening hours in Scotland. However, events lead her to begin a process of self-discovery.

metas.name: Love Lies Bleeding
metas.description: Reclusive gym manager Lou falls hard for Jackie, an ambitious bodybuilder headed through town to Vegas in pursuit of her dream. But their love ignites violence, pulling them deep into the web of Lou's criminal family.
